judgement.why_this_decision: Event 008, 'Yes please arrange an engineer, thank you', answers event 004's request for approval to arrange an appliance engineer. classify_reply scored it as an unconditional approval at 0.9, so I recorded the approval. The property history shows ticket 77 with the same description, the same created timestamp, and the same tenant and landlord names. Dispatching from both tickets would book the engineer twice, and there is also no named contractor on 76. So the right next step is for a human to pick one working ticket.
